text.line.m.a1.01.dawn.1: First light, and the fog is already in the cranes. Tow truck is warm. Come to the gate.
text.line.m.a1.01.gate: There you are. Keys are in the truck by the gate.
text.line.m.a1.01.hook: Hooked. Easy now, nobody rushes a tow.
text.line.m.a1.01.radio: Dispatch says a robotaxi quit on Third Street and is blocking the lane. Free tow if you beat the company truck.
text.line.m.a1.01.tow: Bring it home slow. Nothing on it gets scratched.
text.line.m.a1.01.truck: Take the truck. It idles rough, so give it a minute.
text.line.m.a1.02.fare: Thanks for stopping. The app promised a car ten minutes ago, so I will take yours.
text.line.m.a1.02.home: Clean getaway. Back to the Yard before the fog does.
text.line.m.a1.02.patrol: Patrol saw your plates on the way out. Lose them and come home.
text.line.m.a1.02.race: The company car already left with the same fare number. You have four minutes.
text.line.m.a1.02.text: Fare waiting at Fourth and King. Surge pricing is up and the robotaxis are late. Go.
text.line.m.a1.03.follow: Stay close. The crowd is already there.
text.line.m.a1.03.gate: Sunday night, the lot behind the cranes. Bring a car that likes to slide.
text.line.m.a1.03.home: Everybody scattered. Get back to the Yard before the next patrol comes through.
text.line.m.a1.03.raid: Patrol is on the lot. Lose them and head for the Yard.
text.line.m.a1.03.raid.1: Lights! Patrol on the fence line, everybody out the back!
text.line.m.a1.03.raid.2: Go, go. Do not stop for anything!
text.line.m.a1.03.show: Give them a show. Three thousand points of smoke and the lot is yours.
text.line.m.a1.04.keynote.1: Every curb in this city is a lot. Every lot is a number. Tonight we put a number on all of them.
text.line.m.a1.04.keynote.2: Mark the map, price the block, own the city.
text.line.m.a1.04.out: Walk out like you belong. The photo is all we need.
text.line.m.a1.04.photo: Got it. Now stay for the keynote and keep your head down.
text.line.m.a1.04.start: Odessa here. The launch party is tonight. Get in the line and find a way up to the screen.
text.line.m.a1.04.talk.door.open: Name is not on the list, friend. Unless you can make it worth my while.
text.line.m.a1.04.talk.influencer.open: Stream is live! Are you here for the launch? Say hi to chat.
text.line.m.a1.05.bout: Ring is set! Two rounds, no weapons, the crowd decides.
text.line.m.a1.05.lose: You went down swinging. The crowd respects that.
text.line.m.a1.05.ring.1: The turntable turns, the crowd closes in. Ladies and gentlemen, the ring is open.
text.line.m.a1.05.start: Saint here. The turntable at Powell and Market is open tonight. Come see what the Chorus is building.
text.line.m.a1.05.talk.signup.open: Welcome to the turntable! Folks are signing up for an exhibition bout. Want a spot?
text.line.m.a1.05.win: That is how it is done! The Chorus will remember you.
text.line.m.a1.06.antenna.1: Up it goes. For the first time the whole block can hear itself.
text.line.m.a1.06.convoy: The van is rolling. Stay on it and do not let anything touch it.
text.line.m.a1.06.start: Saint here. The Chorus van is loaded at the warehouse. Meet it there and we move before the signal window closes.
text.line.m.a1.06.sweep: Patrol sweep on the hill road. Lose them before you go up.
text.line.m.a1.07.civic: Civic Center is a few blocks on. Keep Patch in the open and walk like you are late for lunch.
text.line.m.a1.07.drones: Halcyon survey drones are sweeping the park. Stay off the paths and keep moving.
text.line.m.a1.07.msg: Patch is waiting at the Hacker House. Go easy on the neighbors and keep to the park path. Odessa
text.line.m.a1.07.patch.come: Right, I am coming with you. The house is not safe once a drone has read my door.
text.line.m.a1.07.patch.thanks: You walked me the whole way. I owe you a decoded pod and a very large favor.
text.line.m.a1.07.start: Odessa here. The Cerebral live in the painted house by Alamo Square. Their lead, Patch, can read the pod. Go and ask nicely.
text.line.m.a1.07.talk.patch.open: Door is open and the router is on fire. Is that the pod? Hand it here, or tell me why you will not.
text.line.m.a1.08.gate: That is the depot gate. Get one clear photo of the plates on the fence and the sensor racks behind them.
text.line.m.a1.08.lurk: Quiet now. The mapping cars come by on the hour. Listen for the hum.
text.line.m.a1.08.patrol: The depot called it in. A patrol is on you. Lose it and head for home.
text.line.m.a1.08.plant: A second car is leaving the depot. Pull up close and hold there. My dongle only needs a few seconds of the bumper.
text.line.m.a1.08.planted: Dongle is in. That car will now tell us where it has been. Get out of there.
text.line.m.a1.08.scanner.1: They map the same blocks every night. Tonight we map them back.
text.line.m.a1.08.start: Patch here, on the encrypted line. The Halcyon mapping cars run dark at night. Get a car and wait by the Yard gate.
text.line.m.a1.08.tail: There it goes. Stay back, stay in sight, and do not let it lose you.
text.line.m.a1.09.flagged: Sergeant Bell on the patrol channel: the Yard's tow truck is on the hot list. All units, that is the one.
text.line.m.a1.09.hide: Fresh paint, same engine. Now get under the freeway viaduct and let the patrol lose you.
text.line.m.a1.09.home: Quiet street, clean truck. Bring it home before the sun is up.
text.line.m.a1.09.sprayed: Odessa here. Half an hour in the booth and the truck is a new color. The patrol has no plate to chase.
text.line.m.a1.09.start: Odessa here. The depot cameras caught our tow truck. Take it out of the Yard and get it to the body shop in Dogpatch before they box it in.
text.line.m.a1.10.clock: Doors close at half past five. Everyone you asked is already walking over. Get to the steps.
text.line.m.a1.10.msg: The hearing starts soon. Three neighbors still need to hear the plan before they decide. Can you reach them?
text.line.m.a1.10.start: Imani Hart, Curb Allocation Board. Public comment on the curb auction closes at five thirty, and the room is full of people paid to say yes. Find three neighbors who will say what they see.
text.line.m.a1.10.steps.1: The doors are open. Anyone who wants to speak, line up on the steps. Everyone gets two minutes, and I will keep the clock.
text.line.m.a1.10.talk.kai.open: I made flyers about the curb maps. Nobody reads flyers. Do you really think they will listen to me?
text.line.m.a1.10.talk.moss.open: I drove the number fourteen for thirty years. I know every curb on this street, and nobody asked me about a single one.
text.line.m.a1.10.talk.tran.open: My awning has been on this corner since before the lots had numbers. They want to price it by the foot?
text.line.m.a1.11.msg: Market night. I will talk you through the trucks once you have said hello to the raffle guest.
text.line.m.a1.11.patrol: The tow companies called it in. A patrol is rolling on you. Lose it and go home.
text.line.m.a1.11.start: X Ramos on the dispatch line. The market is full tonight and the guest of honor is drawing tickets. Say hello, then keep your eyes on the curb.
text.line.m.a1.11.talk.raffle.open: Ticket number seven thousand and one! Come over, there is a prize with your name on it, and I promise it is not a parking ticket.
text.line.m.a1.11.trucks: Three Halcyon compliance trucks just pulled out to clear the stalls. Get a car and block every one of them in before the market is gone.
text.line.m.a1.12.arrival.1: Quite a place you have here. I came to see what the Yard is worth, and now I think I should ask you.
text.line.m.a1.12.fog: The helicopter lost you in the fog. A few cruisers are still on your tail. Shake them.
text.line.m.a1.12.home: The Yard gate is lit. Bring the truck in and let the pod's story ride home with you.
text.line.m.a1.12.lot: Look at the screen. That is our street with a number on it. Get in the car, they are coming.
text.line.m.a1.12.lot-one.1: Every curb in this city is a lot. Lot number one is a street called home. Our crews begin tonight.
text.line.m.a1.12.lot-one.2: Units to the plaza. Take the driver in the plain car, and nobody gets hurt.
text.line.m.a1.12.msg: Big screen at the plaza by the arena. I am going live in a minute. Do not miss this.
text.line.m.a1.12.run: Security is rolling out. Helicopter, spike strips, everything they have. Stay moving for two minutes, no matter what.
text.line.m.a1.12.start: Saint here, live. They are about to put a number on the Yard. Get to the plaza by the arena and watch the big screen.
text.line.m.a1.12.talk.whitney.open: I run a fund that has a stake in this auction. Before anyone writes a headline, would you like to hear what I can do for the Yard?
text.mission.m.a1.01.fail.ko: You went down. Get up and try again.
text.mission.m.a1.01.fail.pod: The stalled car is wrecked. Start the tow again.
text.mission.m.a1.01.fail.tow: The tow truck is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.01.obj.deliver_pod: Tow the stalled car back to the Yard
text.mission.m.a1.01.obj.enter_tow_again: Get back in the tow truck
text.mission.m.a1.01.obj.goto_stall: Pull up beside the stalled robotaxi on Third Street

text.mission.m.a1.02.fail.ko: You went down. Get up and try again.
text.mission.m.a1.02.fail.ride: The car is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.02.fail.rival: The company car got there first.
text.mission.m.a1.02.obj.deliver_fare: Get your fare to the 24th Street station plaza
text.mission.m.a1.02.obj.goto_pickup: Pull up at Fourth and King
text.mission.m.a1.02.obj.meet_fare: Meet your fare on the sidewalk

text.mission.m.a1.03.obj.goto_gate: Meet Tavi at the Yard gate
text.mission.m.a1.03.obj.goto_lot: Drive to the lot behind the cranes
text.mission.m.a1.03.title: Sideshow Sunday
text.mission.m.a1.04.fail.host: The door host is hurt. The party is shut down.
text.mission.m.a1.04.fail.screen: The screen is wrecked. There is nothing left to photograph.
text.mission.m.a1.04.obj.stealth_front: Slip up to the exec floor
text.mission.m.a1.04.talk.influencer.intent: Say hello to the streamer in the line
text.mission.m.a1.04.title: Curb Appeal
text.mission.m.a1.05.obj.wait_crowd: Wait for the crowd to close in
text.mission.m.a1.05.talk.signup.intent: Sign up for the exhibition bout
text.mission.m.a1.05.title: Turntable Battle
text.mission.m.a1.06.fail.van: The van is wrecked. The signal window closed.
text.mission.m.a1.06.obj.goto_hill: Drive the van up to the hill
text.mission.m.a1.06.obj.goto_warehouse: Meet the Chorus at the warehouse
text.mission.m.a1.06.title: Signal Boost
text.mission.m.a1.07.fail.patch: Patch got hurt. The house will not talk to you now.
text.mission.m.a1.07.obj.collect_patch: Walk Patch out of the house
text.mission.m.a1.07.obj.goto_house: Go to the hacker house by Alamo Square
text.mission.m.a1.07.obj.stealth_park: Cross Alamo Square past the survey drones
text.mission.m.a1.07.obj.talk_patch: Talk to Patch about the pod
text.mission.m.a1.07.talk.patch.doubt: I keep the pod. You can look, not touch
text.mission.m.a1.07.talk.patch.intent: Decide whether Patch gets the pod
text.mission.m.a1.07.title: Hacker House
text.mission.m.a1.08.fail.ride: Your car is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.08.obj.chase_scanner: Pull up close to the second mapping car
text.mission.m.a1.08.obj.enter_ride: Get a car and wait at the Yard gate
text.mission.m.a1.08.obj.follow_scanner: Follow the mapping car to its depot
text.mission.m.a1.08.title: Dead Pixels
text.mission.m.a1.09.fail.tow: The tow truck is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.09.obj.escape_viaduct: Lose the patrol under the freeway viaduct
text.mission.m.a1.09.obj.goto_shop: Pull into the body shop in Dogpatch
text.mission.m.a1.09.title: Respray
text.mission.m.a1.10.obj.goto_kai: Find the teenager with the flyers
text.mission.m.a1.10.obj.goto_steps: Get to the City Hall steps before the doors close
text.mission.m.a1.10.obj.goto_tran: Find the shopkeeper on his corner
text.mission.m.a1.10.obj.talk_moss: Ask the bus driver to speak
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.kai.agree: Your flyers are the best map of the block. Say it in the room
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.kai.decline: No pressure. Keep handing out the flyers
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.kai.intent: Ask Kai to speak at the hearing
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.moss.agree: You know these curbs better than the map. Come and say so
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.moss.decline: Rest your feet. Thank you for telling me about the route
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.moss.intent: Ask Ms. Moss to speak at the hearing
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.tran.agree: Your awning is the story. Tell them what it cost to hang it
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.tran.decline: Understood. The shop needs you open tonight
text.mission.m.a1.10.talk.tran.intent: Ask Mr. Tran to speak at the hearing

text.mission.m.a1.11.obj.enter_ride: Grab a car at the end of the market

text.mission.m.a1.11.talk.raffle.thanks: Thanks, the whole block loves the raffle
